conventions.local_clifford: maps at OUTPUT party j are row-major [[a,b],[c,d]] acting (x,z); perm[i] is destination of input i; apply P_perm, then canonical local Cliffords, then listed binary Pauli correction. Binary canonical Clifford sends X to i^(a*c) X^a Z^c and Z to i^(b*d) X^b Z^d. Odd-prime canonical Cliffords send centered Weyls to centered Weyls; arbitrary common phases are immaterial.
conventions.isometry_recipe: Let L, Q, D and eta_exponent be specified. alpha=exp(2*pi*i*eta_exponent/(4*L))*Q/sqrt(D). Let R[t,a]=1 if t=prime_slope*a mod p. For j=0,...,L-1 set E_j=(1/L)*sum_(v=0)^(L-1) exp(-2*pi*i*j*v/L)*conjugate(alpha)^v and F_j with R instead. Form orthonormal A_j and B_j by Gram-Schmidt of the ordered columns of E_j and F_j, skipping zero residuals and dividing by the positive square root of the residual squared norm. V=sum_j B_j[:,:rank(E_j)]*A_j^dagger. This is a deterministic finite algebraic prescription, including every normalization; it is not a numerical eigensolver.
